The shared target of these two molecules, Serine-protein kinase ATM, implies a potential mechanism of action where the compound may influence the receptor through this kinase. The evidence is consistent across two distinct pathways, suggesting a possible role in signaling pathways involving the Prostaglandin D2 receptor.
